reasons.plan: Adeline wants a go-wide attack plan and has some support in Inquisitorial Rosette, Divine Visitation, Worthy Knight and Springjack Shepherd, but many cards don't serve it, such as Dawn-Blessed Pennant, Tsabo's Web, Harper Recruiter, Righteous Avengers and Luck Bobblehead.
reasons.fit: The change cuts the weak Golden Egg and Tine Shrike and adds two removal pieces, but Loran only hits artifacts and enchantments and Molten-Tail Masticore is a clunky upkeep-discard card, so removal improves only modestly.
reasons.mana: Mono-white colours are dependable, but 45 lands (43 Plains plus Cactus Preserve and Makindi Mesas, both entering tapped) is far too many for a curve centred on 3.
reasons.ramp: Only Commander's Sphere, Darksteel Ingot, Luck Bobblehead and arguably Foundry Inspector accelerate the mana, which is thin for a deck with eight cards at 6 or more mana.
reasons.draw: Draw is mostly small one-shot cantrips (Fountain of Renewal, Implement of Improvement, Scroll of Avacyn, Novice Inspector, Combat Thresher, Wrench), with Loran and Ginger's monarch as the only repeatable sources.
reasons.interaction: Removal is a few narrow or expensive pieces (Loran, Arbalest Elite, Tower of Calamities, Molten-Tail Masticore, Curse of Conformity), plus tappers and Cliffside Rescuer and Haystack for protection, with only the unwieldy Worldslayer as a reset.

details.summary: An Adeline aggro deck diluted by many off-plan cards, a bloated 45-land base and little ramp. The refine adds two modest removal pieces as asked, but doesn't add much interaction.

reasons.ramp: There are about five ramp pieces (Commander's Sphere, Darksteel Ingot, Luck Bobblehead, Alpha Myr, Golden Egg) plus Foundry Inspector, which is adequate for this curve.
reasons.draw: Draw is mostly one-shot cantrip artifacts (Golden Egg, Tsabo's Web, Scroll of Avacyn, Implement of Improvement, Wrench, Novice Inspector's Clue), with only symmetric Loran and narrow Harper Recruiter repeating.
reasons.interaction: Answers are thin and narrow: Loran's one artifact or enchantment, Arbalest Elite, the overcosted Tower of Calamities, tappers like Fiend Binder, and protection from Cliffside Rescuer and Haystack, with no real sweeper.

reasons.plan: A coherent Zombie sacrifice-and-recursion shell for Sheoldred (Fleshbag Marauder, Midnight Reaper, Undead Augur, Victimize, Open the Graves), with a handful of loose cards such as Render Inert, Battle-Rage Blessing, Grisly Transformation and Idol of Oblivion.
reasons.fit: All ten cards at 6+ mana were cut and replaced with cards at 5 or less, several matching the cut cards' jobs (Crippling Fear as a sweeper, Open the Graves and Lord of the Accursed for Zombie payoffs), though Render Inert and Grisly Transformation are weak stand-ins.
reasons.mana: Mono-black with 33 lands (30 Swamps), only Uncharted Haven entering tapped, and a curve topping out at 5 apart from the commander, backed by about nine mana rocks.
reasons.ramp: Around nine pieces (Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Thought Vessel, Commander's Sphere, Heraldic Banner, Phyrexian Atlas, Unstable Obelisk, Hedron Archive, Wayfarer's Bauble) plus land-fetching Pilgrim's Eye and Skittering Surveyor.
reasons.draw: Plenty of repeatable sacrifice-fuelled draw (Braids, Midnight Reaper, Undead Augur, Vampiric Rites, Spark Reaper, Gibbering Barricade) alongside one-shots like Phyrexian Rager, Skyscanner and Liliana's Standard Bearer.
reasons.interaction: Many creature answers (Cut Down, Fell, Murder, Deadly Derision, Bone Splinters, Feed the Swarm, Final Flourish, Syphon Flesh) and a Crippling Fear sweeper, but few answers to artifacts and enchantments.

reasons.plan: There is a loose white-creatures attack plan with Divine Visitation, Inquisitorial Rosette, Makindi Stampede and Worthy Knight, but well over a fifth of the deck is off-plan filler such as Bargain, Dawn-Blessed Pennant, Tsabo's Web, Tine Shrike and Celestial Mantle.
reasons.fit: It cuts exactly 4 Plains to reach 37 lands as asked, but of the added creatures only Alpha Myr and Loran are cheap bodies, while The Dawning Archaic (10 mana with few instants or sorceries) and the 6-mana Defenestrated Phantom do little for a go-wide Adeline deck.

reasons.interaction: Answers are few and clunky: Loran, Arbalest Elite, Tower of Calamities, Molten-Tail Masticore and the risky Worldslayer, plus tappers and minor protection like Haystack and Cliffside Rescuer, with no real sweeper.

details.summary: The land cut was done correctly, but the new creatures are mostly poor fits for Adeline. The deck is a mono-white pile with a sound mana base, a vague go-wide plan, and weak ramp and interaction.

reasons.plan: Most cards serve a Kangee flyers-beatdown plan (Steel-Plume Marshal, Kangee's Lieutenant, Favorable Winds, Thunderclap Wyvern, Gravitational Shift), but around ten cards such as Felidar Retreat, White Sun's Zenith, Lightshell Duo, Whiskervale Forerunner and Vow of Duty sit outside it.
reasons.fit: It reaches exactly 36 lands and adds two ramp pieces (Sol Ring, Arcane Signet) while cutting mostly weak cards like Feather of Flight, Zhalfirin Shapecraft and Mind Spiral, though cutting on-theme Empyrean Eagle and Skyscanner is debatable.
reasons.mana: Thirty-six lands suit a curve topping at 5-7 in a two-colour deck, but five taplands (Coastal Tower, Meandering River, Sejiri Refuge, Temple of Enlightenment, Tranquil Cove) plus conditional Port Town and Prairie Stream add some slowness.
reasons.ramp: About eight pieces (Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Azorius Signet, Talisman of Progress, Commander's Sphere, Sky Diamond, Hedron Archive, Wayfarer's Bauble) plus Warden of Evos Isle's discount cover a mostly 2-4 mana curve.
reasons.draw: Plenty of sources including repeatable engines like Windreader Sphinx, Tide Skimmer, Bident of Thassa, Staggering Insight and Faerie Mastermind, backed by Sphinx's Revelation, Inspiring Overseer, Winged Words and Deep Analysis.
reasons.interaction: Well over eight flexible answers: Counterspell, Absorb, Sinister Sabotage, Negate, Prayer of Binding, Hanged Executioner, Cut Short, Disenchant and Crush Contraband, plus Cleansing Nova and Time Wipe as board resets.

details.summary: A solid Azorius flyers deck that now has a healthy mana base and good draw and interaction, though a handful of off-theme cards dilute the Kangee plan. The refine did what was asked with mostly sensible cuts.
